name: Transformers
tagline: A library of pretrained machine-learning models for text, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks.
hook: Warns that AttributeError values are converter directives and that one modular edit can regenerate several models.
summary: The root AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md symlinks resolve to .ai/AGENTS.md. This short file concentrates on contribution coordination and generated-model mechanics, explaining how legacy copies and current modular sources must be edited and checked.

techniques.title: Distinguish current generators from legacy copies
techniques.body: The file describes two mechanisms for maintaining standalone model files. It permits existing copied blocks to be maintained through their source but directs new work toward modular files.
techniques.quote: **Do not add new `# Copied from` statements**; write a modular file instead.

techniques.title: Inspect the full output of a shared source change
techniques.body: A named modular file also generates another model family. The guide requires regeneration and review of every changed output, so a fix cannot quietly leave dependent generated code stale.
techniques.quote: **Other models inherit your modular file.** `modular_deepseek_vl.py` also generates `modeling_deepseek_vl_hybrid.py`.

techniques.title: Explain a value that looks like a mistake
techniques.body: AttributeError is intentional converter syntax for removing inherited members. The file explains that replacing it with an apparently sensible value can change model sharding behavior.
techniques.quote: **`attr = AttributeError()` deletes an inherited attribute** — it is an instruction to the converter, not a bug or placeholder.

techniques.title: Check ownership and overlapping work before contributing
techniques.body: Before a PR, agents must coordinate on the issue and inspect open work. The guide supplies issue and PR queries and asks for an explanation when a different approach warrants another patch.
techniques.quote: Check for overlapping work, and do not open a second PR for a fix already covered:

steal: Explain the source of truth for generated model files.
Review every generated output affected by a shared source edit.
Document special sentinel values that resemble errors.
Check issue ownership and existing patches before opening a PR.
